REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - SEPTEMBER 24, 2020 -
07:00 P.M.
TELECONFERENCE MEETING AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20 VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID #858 1932 5724
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, the City Council Chamber and City Hall are closed to the public. Consistent with State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the Los Angeles County Health Officer’s “Safer at Home Order for Control of COVID-19” the City Council will participate in the meeting through teleconference. Public participation in the meeting will be facilitated through the electronic methods as described below.
Agenda Materials:
The agenda and agenda packet related to items on this agenda are available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION:
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us and on Cerritos TV3.
Public Comments:
Members of the public may provide public comment through the following methods:
Email: Members of the public may provide public comment by submitting an email to city_clerk@cerritos.us by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the meeting date and agenda item number for which you would like to provide comment in the subject line of the email. The public comment will be distributed to all members of the City Council. During the meeting your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: You may provide audio public comment by connecting to the teleconference meeting online or by telephone/mobile call (please select only one method). Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time on the agenda. You must be available to provide comment at the time you are called upon to speak. If you are not planning on providing public comment we encourage you to observe the meeting via livestream or on Cerritos TV3 to allow staff to more effectively manage the number of teleconference connections.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/85819325724
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 858 1932 5724
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations:
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 24, 2020, 7:00 P.M., TELECONFERENCED MEETING
AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20,
VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 858 1932 5724

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  Councilmember Hu reported she would be unable to serve as the City’s Voting Delegate for
  the 2020 League of California Cities Annual Conference and Business Meeting scheduled
  for October 7 - 9, 2020, citing scheduling conflicts. She requested the City Council
  appoint another member of the City Council to serve in this capacity.

  MOTION TO RECONSIDER CITY COUNCIL ACTION TAKEN ON AUGUST 27, 2020
  (AGENDA ITEM 9C) TO DESIGNATE A VOTING DELEGATE AND ALTERNATES FOR
  THE 2020 LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES ANNUAL CONFERENCE AND BUSINESS
  MEETING SCHEDULED FOR OCTOBER 7 - 9, 2020 (COUNCIL): It was moved by
  Solanki, and seconded by Vo, to:

  1. Make the finding that a change to the City’s Voting Delegate and Alternates for the
  2020 League of California Cities Annual Conference and Business Meeting scheduled
  for October 7, 2020 was determined to be necessary subsequent to the posting of
  the September 24, 2020 agenda and requires City Council action prior to the next
  scheduled City Council meeting in order to meet the League of California Cities
  deadline to designate the final Voting Delegate and Alternates; and

  2. Reconsider the designation of a Voting Delegate and Alternates for the 2020 League
  of California Cities Annual Conference and Business Meeting scheduled for October
  7 - 9, 2020 (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  September 24, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 11

5.  Presentations/Appointments (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Hu, to:

  1. Designate Councilmember Barrows, as Voting Delegate, and Councilmember
  Yokoyama, as Voting Alternate, as officially authorized to cast the City’s vote at the
  2020 League of California Cities Annual Business Meeting currently scheduled for
  Friday, October 9, 2020; and

  2. Direct the City Clerk to complete the official 2020 Annual Conference Voting
  Delegate/Alternate Form (Form), including attestation of the City Council’s majority
  action to designate a Voting Delegate and Alternate, and submit such Form to the
  League Credentials Committee by the September 30, 2020 deadline (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer presented an informational update on the November 3,
  2020 General Election. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Written correspondence
  (Written correspondence is considered public record and full-text copies of submitted
  written correspondence can be obtained in the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer)

  John Moran submitted written correspondence regarding commercial vehicle traffic on
  Bloomfield Avenue and 166th Street.

  Audio public comments

  John Moran spoke regarding commercial vehicle traffic on Bloomfield Avenue and 166 th
  Street.

  Margaret Villa expressed concern regarding information circulating in the community of
  an Amazon Grocery Store opening in Cerritos. (Audio public comments were reopened
  after Item 8C as this speaker had technical difficulty connecting to the ZOOM
  teleconference meeting. The audio for this speaker can be found on the meeting video
  after consideration of Item 8C.)

  Noting there were no other individuals who provided written correspondence or elected
  to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  (minutes continue on the next page)
 City of Cerritos  September 24, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 11

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of September

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Hu, to approve the City

  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  City of Cerritos  9/24/2020  $ 1,656,308.95 (COUNCIL)

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7D.  Receive and file the 2020 Local Agency Biennial Notice pursuant to the Political Reform
  Act of 1974 and direct any proposed amendments to be presented to the City Council
  and its subagencies at their December 10, 2020 meeting (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Hu, to:

  1. Receive and file the 2020 local agency biennial notice; and

  2. Direct the Office of the City Clerk to present any changes to the conflict of interest codes
  to the City Council and appropriate City subagencies for their review, consideration, and
  potential adoption at the December 10, 2020 meeting (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  Yokoyama
  ABSENT:  None

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration of an appeal by project applicant Kia of Cerritos of the
  Planning Commission decision (Planning Commission Resolution No. PC 2020-9) denying
  a proposal for an automobile repair use located at 10742, 10750 and 10754 Artesia
  Boulevard, currently zoned Industrial (M) (APN 7034-018-117 and APN 7034-018-009),
  and all related entitlements, including General Plan Amendment 2020-1, Development
  Plan Amendment 2020-1, and Conditional Use Permit 2020-1 (COUNCIL).

  Staff reports were given by Robert Lopez, Director of Community Development, Kristin
  Aguila, Advance Planning/Economic Development Manager, and Sandy Cisneros, Senior
  Planner. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  Mayor Pro Tem Vo stated for the record he had spoken with the owners of B & B Stables
  and representatives from Kia of Cerritos to gather more information regarding this
  matter.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments period.

  Jonathan Matson, representing the appellant, Kia of Cerritos, introduced and made
  himself available for any questions.

  Written correspondence
  (Written correspondence is considered public record and full-text copies of submitted
  written correspondence can be obtained in the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer)

  The following individuals submitted written correspondence in opposition to approval of
  the appeal submitted by Kia of Cerritos of the Planning Commission’s decision on this
  matter: Leann Bakker, John Evenhouse, Eric Kooi, Karlene Taylor, Kim Bouma, John
  Grasmeyer, Brad Struiksma, Jeffrey Struiksma, and Mona Gisler.

  The following individuals submitted written correspondence in support of approval of the
  appeal submitted by Kia of Cerritos of the Planning Commission’s decision on this
  matter: Gene and Olga Sais, John Bowen, Kirk Benson, Yosemite Hamilton, and Reed
  Amiri.
 City of Cerritos  September 24, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 11

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8A.  (continued)

  Audio public comments

  John Moran spoke regarding a City ordinance regarding repair of vehicles at the Cerritos
  Auto Square.

  Mary Buell stated she had spoken with representatives of Kia of Cerritos and would be in
  support of the approval of their appeal if she could be assured Kia of Cerritos would be
  required to adhere to amended conditions of approval including relocation of the auto
  repair section of the proposed facility and the prohibition of pneumatic equipment use.

  Jonathan Matson, Kia of Cerritos, stated that Kia of Cerritos would be amenable to
  amended conditions of approval to include relocation of the auto repair section of the
  proposed facility and the prohibition of pneumatic equipment use.

  Kirk Benson, Kia of Cerritos, also stated that Kia of Cerritos would be amenable to
  amended conditions of approval to include relocation of the auto repair section of the
  proposed facility and the prohibition of pneumatic equipment use.

  Noting there were no other individuals who provided written correspondence or elected
  to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Hu, to:

  1. Continue the public hearing to a date certain, Monday, October 5, 2020, 7:00 p.m.;
  and

  2. Include the stated revisions to the proposed conditions of approval for City Council
  consideration at the continued public hearing; and

  3. Include any other proposed conditions of approval for City Council consideration at
  the continued public hearing which may be required as a result of staff negotiations
  with the appellant (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
